messages:
ani: Quick sync: proposing 'stepped-surge-and-shadow-run' for the next routing change. Goals: controlled exposure, tenant-level pause, shadow A/B for cost-vs-quality, and a single composite hard-stop.
logan: Sounds good. My preference: explicit tenant lists for each cohort (critical, paid, trial) instead of vague percentages. Easier audit and support.
maria: Telemetry gates idea: if P99 latency increases >20% OR client-visible error rate +0.6% absolute for 10m -> trigger hard-stop. Also token-per-response +35% for 15m -> throttle.
ops-bot: alert-bot: composite alert 'stepped-surge-composite' created. Conditions: p99_delta_10m>20 || err_abs_10m>0.6 || tokens_resp_15m>35. Page when cohort_rps>0.5.
devops: Fallback flow: on hard-stop, swap affected tenants to pinned route "route-v2-stable" and mark rollout=PAUSED. Auto-retry attempt after 15m; if stable for 8m, resume to previous allocation. Manual rollback window = 45m.
logan: Add soft-kill API for customer-ops: POST /rollouts/{id}/pause?tenant={tenant_id}. Should be able to pause single tenant without affecting cohort.
ani: Agreed. Also run a 72h shadow mirror to v3-small for output-quality scoring (store diffs, redact PII, retention 14d).
ryan: For burst protection, require both 5m and 15m windows to exceed thresholds before escalating to oncall. Avoid noisy transient pages.
maria: Playbook checklist for moving region->region: 1) shadow run >=48h with quality pass, 2) golden cohort stable 24h, 3) soft-kill exercised by oncall, 4) baselines uploaded to config-store.
devops: deploy-bot: rollout started: stepped-surge -> us-west1, cohort=critical-list, rollout_id=roll-1820000001. Hooks: latency,error,tokens,quality. Samples saved -> s3://rollouts/stepped-surge/1820000001/samples.jsonl
ani: I'll update the flag payload to use explicit tenant lists and wire the soft-kill endpoint. Can folks ack when they've read the playbook?
logan: Ack.
maria: Ack.
ryan: Ack.
